name: reading-instrument/layer-helix
refs: THE PICKED DIRECTION (project-owned): the screen whose instrument, light and colours this layer must match.
prompt: Paint ONE straight vertical DOUBLE HELIX, centred, running the full height of the canvas, on a PURE BLACK background, as a lit object for a game screen. Two smooth ribbons of frosted glowing glass twist round each other at an even pitch (about six full turns over the height), with thin soft rungs between them; the ribbon in front is brighter and wider, the one behind dimmer and thinner; each ribbon has a bright specular core and a soft bloom around it; the light is NEUTRAL WHITE with no colour of its own (the game tints it); the helix is perfectly regular from top to bottom so it can be repeated. Nothing else: no particles, no text, no background, no frame.
